description: This Java class 'AndroidXmlExtension' extends 'DefaultXmlExtension' to provide Android-specific XML handling, including reference creation, namespace prefix management, and resource file validation within the IntelliJ IDEA Android plugin environment.

classes.name: AndroidXmlExtension
classes.description: A class extending DefaultXmlExtension to handle Android-specific XML namespace and reference logic within the IDE.

methods.name: createTagNameReference
methods.description: Creates a TagNameReference for Android XML tags, returning null if references are provided by the reference provider.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Determines if the Android XML extension is applicable to the given file, checking project, resource directory, and manifest status.

methods.name: getPrefixDeclaration
methods.description: Provides namespace prefix declaration, returning a dummy prefix for empty prefixes in Android XML files to avoid unbound namespace errors.
